protocol_status: Declared before candidate scores were computed; exploratory, not preregistered

calibration.rates: odd integer request rates 1-99, paired datasets in same split
calibration.low_lifetime_anchors: odd rates 11-29 passing low-drift screen in the calibration window only
calibration.high_rate_proxy: odd rates >=60, Waiting positive at all calibration snapshots
calibration.concurrency_hypothesis: maximum Running among calibration snapshots only
calibration.service_curve: conditional departures vs mean Running; high-regime median anchor; monotone regularization and linear interpolation

comparison.initial_state: first observed Running/Waiting in window; subsequent states not supplied
comparison.unobserved_initial_remaining_work: uniform quantiles on (0,1), sensitivity using quantiles squared and square-root
comparison.input: regular arrivals at configured rate, not observed request admission timestamps
comparison.reason: All NLR rates have already been inspected during earlier research; this split prevents numeric calibration reuse, not prior-knowledge leakage

models.B0_persistence: hold initial observed stocks; nonmechanistic diagnostic reference
models.F1_short_lifetime: FIFO slots with one fixed low-load lifetime; simplified PL43 scaffold, not full TTFT/TBT model
models.F2_capacity_lifetime: same FIFO slots, lifetime=K/conditional high-load rate; diagnostic opposing calibration
models.S1_state_dependent_lps: fixed-K state-dependent limited processor sharing; Gupta & Zhang 2022 Eq2-3; NLR empirical service curve and unit work are adaptations

integration: event driven; arrivals and completions determine updates, output sampling does not set dynamics
aggregation: per-run metrics, then equal-run mean by service and request-rate band

references.scope: lifetime/FIFO/active count scaffold; Eq6; not a full reproduction
Gupta and Zhang, Stochastic Systems 12(2),205-225; Sec2.1 Eq2-3; not their diffusion/control algorithm
local raw server scheduler snapshots and configured benchmark metadata
